title: Zircord Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Zircord Discord Rich Presence

afkTimeoutMinutes.description: Inactivity timeout in minutes before entering AFK mode

showButtons.description: Show interactive GitHub and Profile buttons

profileUrl.description: Custom developer profile or portfolio URL

enableRobloxDetection.description: Automatically detect Roblox Studio, Rojo, and Bloxstrap processes

enableFreebuffDetection.description: Automatically detect Freebuff AI Agent runs, active projects, and prompts

enableKiroDetection.description: Automatically detect Kiro AI CLI sessions, active workspaces, and prompts

enableAgentDetection.description: Automatically detect AI Coding Agents (Claude Code, Cursor Agent, Aider, AGY, etc.)

enableCliDetection.description: Automatically detect active CLI tools, compilers, package managers, and terminals
